bundle.shortDescription: A product-neutral workspace for agent services
bundle.longDescription: Agent Workspace is the native host for the product-neutral web workspace. It connects to user-authorized agent services and supports secure credentials and remote connections. Embedding products supply their own identity and managed-service configuration.
